This record supersedes the one rendered on `bc491118`; the finding that head's record raised (the assign leg of an off-relay gap) is what this head answers.

### ① Derived judgments

The net diff against `main` is still four lines for four lines at SKILL.md :198–201 (〈路径分叉〉 rule ③). The delta from the previous head is :201 alone: 「缺口经中继 `pr_request_reviewers` 补」 → 「缺口经中继 `pr_request_reviewers`/`assign` 补」. Lines :198–200 are byte-identical to the previous head, and the judgments on them stand; they are restated here so this record reads whole.

1. :198 「中继 `pr_create`/`pr_ready` 命中 Tier H 即向 `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` 中未请/派/审者请审」 — RIGHT. `GOVERNED_REVIEW_OPS` is derived from the rows carrying `governedReview: true`, exactly `pr_create` and `pr_ready` (ops.mjs :867, :904; the self-test pins the pair). `governedReviewPlan` sends only on `tier === GOVERNED_TIER_H`; `covered` = requested ∪ assigned ∪ submitted-review (reviewedLogins excludes PENDING), so 「未请/派/审者」 = `missing`. A Tier S diff (the `.claude/**` row alone, this PR) sends nothing.
2. :199 「作者是审批人 ⇒ 指派它、请其余(请它必 422),否则请全员」 — RIGHT in substance. `toAssign = missing.filter(isAuthor)`, `toRequest = missing.filter(not author)`; a non-approver author (the fleet bot, any other login) gets every uncovered approver requested. Precision notes, neither a rule the code does not perform: 「指派它」 and 「请全员」 apply to UNCOVERED approvers, scoped by :198 (an author already assigned by `pr_create`'s assignees leg, execution-duties.md :59, gets nothing sent). 「请它必 422」 matches the plan's own doc comment. 「它」 = 作者, antecedent clear within the clause; the same pronoun for a non-person stands at platform-readings.md :47.
3. :199 「速读只点非作者审批人去批」 — RIGHT as a seat duty (card item 3), not claimed as relay behaviour. Approver author ⇒ the other approver is named; non-approver author ⇒ either qualifies. A direct human merge stays open by rule ② (:189), so nothing narrows.
4. :200 「脱中继开的 PR 无 run 行:交速读前席位恒自读 `requested_reviewers`/`assignees`,⛔ 不只看 run 行」 — RIGHT. The `governed review:` row is pushed only inside the relay run (execute.mjs :835–850), so a PR not opened by the App has none by construction. The seat's hand read omits submitted reviews, which the relay counts as covered; the worst case is a harmless re-request of an approver who COMMENTED, and an APPROVED state is rule ②'s landing case. The card asked for exactly these two fields.
5. :201 「缺口经中继 `pr_request_reviewers`/`assign` 补,⛔ 不碰 draft 位;ACCEPT 与轮报点名脱中继作者」 — RIGHT, and now complete against the per-author rule. `pr_request_reviewers` (ops.mjs :875) is POST `/pulls/{n}/requested_reviewers`, body `reviewers`/`team_reviewers` only. `assign` (ops.mjs :823) is `permission: issues`, required `issue` + `assignees`, ONE POST `/issues/{n}/assignees` — the same endpoint and body shape `governedReviewRequests` (:980) sends for the relay's own `toAssign` leg, and a pull's number is its issue number, so the seat passes the PR number as `issue`. Neither path carries the `draft` field, so 「⛔ 不碰 draft 位」 holds for both (platform-readings.md :45–47 is the measured reading that `update_pull_request`-shaped writes are the ones that do). The two ops together cover both legs of the plan: request the uncovered non-author approvers, assign an uncovered approver-author. The ACCEPT and round-report naming extends contract-review.md :29 「另记作者」 to every Tier H handoff, as the card asked. No rule here that the relay cannot perform; the only thing the seat does that the relay does not is read the fields by hand, which is the card's point.

Survival of the four removed lines (the ratchet's 「砍点逐条核幸存」), clause by clause — unchanged from the previous head:

- old :198 「请审是中继 op」 → SKILL.md :94 「内容写只走 REST 代理,⛔ 无 MCP 写」, rest-channel.md :47 「(Tier H 归中继 op)」, platform-readings.md :47 「请审恒走它;MCP 兜底已拒」, new :201. Carried.
- old :199 「已请审/已指派/已评审者跳过(零写)」 → new :198 「未请/派/审者」; 「PR 作者即其一时请审必 422,op 改为 assign 该账户替代」 → new :199, and the op is now named at :201. Carried.
- old :200 「席位只核对 run 摘要 governed review 行,缺口才手补(免碰 draft 位 REST 路)并在轮次报告点名」 → new :200–201. Carried and strengthened; this is the card's change.
- old :201 「ready/draft 走中继 op」 → platform-readings.md :48, landing-operations.md :51 (「经中继 op `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` 落地,拼写见 `rest-channel.md`」), rest-channel.md :55 (`pr_ready`, reverse `pr_draft`); 「MCP 兜底已拒」 → platform-readings.md :47–48, SKILL.md :94; 「端点见 rest-channel」 → landing-operations.md :51. Carried, with the same honest cost: SKILL.md itself now names `rest-channel.md` nowhere; the reader reaches it via the 阶段细则索引 row for `landing-operations.md` (:88). Acceptable at a 319/319 ceiling.

Card acceptance: the backstop (:200–201), the per-author rule (:199) and the speed-read naming a non-author approver (:199) are present; the per-author rule is exactly `governedReviewPlan`'s computation, and the remedy ops are the relay's own. The declared deviation (prose, not the card's table) is TRUE and accepted: `CEILINGS` pins SKILL.md at 319 and the tree at this head is 319 lines; every plausible `references/*.md` host carries a `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pin of 0 (`compile-surfaces.md` at 352 is not a host); project-forms.md :12 keeps logins out of rules text, so role-word prose is the register's own form; the login table lives in the PR body. The maintainer's verbatim words ask for the behaviour, not the form.

Ambiguities a seat could misread, none blocking: 「它」 (2), 「未请/派/审者」 (a compression of 未请审/未指派/未评审者, recoverable from the old text and the code's `covered`), 「请全员」 (every uncovered approver). The assign-leg gap of the previous record is closed by this head.

Measures read off the tree, not run: SKILL.md at `c79e2346` is 319 lines; :198–201 are 107, 117, 119 and 115 bytes against `MAX_LINE_BYTES` 120 (the commit message says 116; the measured byte count of the committed line is 115 — immaterial, both under budget). `check-governed-prose.mjs` :166 reads SKILL.md for the governed-glob enumeration at :182–183, untouched.

PR body versus tree: the body's "After:" block still shows :201 WITHOUT `/assign`, its "Line ceiling" note says "at most 119 bytes", and its "Gates (local, head `bc491118`)" paragraph names the previous head. The body is a claim, not the governed text, and the diff governs; but the seat should have the body's "After:" block and gates paragraph refreshed to this head (relay `issue_patch`) before the maintainer reads the speed-read, so the body does not misquote the committed rule. Not a FAIL of the text under review.

Check-runs on the head as read (23 runs, started 10:48:37–10:48:39): completed success — No other open PR may claim the same issue. In progress — Lint · repo and tooling gates (hosts the `pm-skill-line-ratchet` step and `check:pm-governed-prose`), Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs and code guards, Lint · CI, release and engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · scoped (tooling self-tests; query-options erasure; slot lookup and corpus), Type Check (workspace; source gates; consumer gates; debt ledger), filter, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check PR Size, Check Documentation Links, The card this PR closes must claim this branch, Part-of PR must not also close its card, No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path. Expected skips — Check Changeset, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in), 18.x upgrade harness (opt-in). No failure on this head at read time. On the previous head `bc491118` the same families had concluded green except the five lint/type jobs that were still running; this head's one-line delta touches nothing those families read differently, but the conclusions here are the gate verdicts and the seat reads every one green before ready. The PR body's local-gates paragraph is a claim about the previous head and is not adopted.

Label `skip-changeset` is on the PR and matches. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body is correct — no published accept set widens or narrows; the plain `no` is the right spelling, the face being decided by the governed path. `Metadata-protocol: none` matches.

No overlap with :198–201, no ceiling collision (both leave SKILL.md at 319). Either order merges cleanly; the second to land takes a routine base sync.
